description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartDao interface, providing data access methods for ShoppingCart entities using JPA queries. It includes methods for retrieving shopping carts by different identifiers and conditions, as well as removing shopping cart entities.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for shopping cart data access, extending a generic DAO and implementing custom shopping cart retrieval methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart entity by its ID.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID, including merchant store details.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by ID and MerchantStore, including line items and attributes.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by code and MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a Customer.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a ShoppingCart entity from persistence.
